overview: Deadfall is a multiplayer FPS for two to twelve players with optional bots and dedicated two-player duels. Slagworks, Switchyard and Stormbreak host four modes, from ordinary deathmatch to flag runs and no-respawn bomb rounds. Players manage two firearms, a knife and up to two grenades from a 36-weapon catalog.
rules: Team Deathmatch ends at the kill target or time limit; Free for All awards individual kills.
Capture the Flag requires bringing the enemy flag home while your own flag is home; dropped flags return after 20 seconds.
Search and Destroy alternates attack/defence: hold use for 3 seconds to plant or 5 seconds to defuse; the fuse lasts 35 seconds, and there are no within-round respawns.
Duels disable bots and require two humans; leaving a live duel forfeits.
Start with the K-9 pistol and knife; pick up map weapons or use E to exchange an occupied slot.
controls: WASD/mouse move/look; left/right mouse fire/aim; Space jumps; Ctrl crouches; Shift sprints; V walks quietly.
R reloads; E uses/swaps pickups or holds to plant/defuse.
1/2/3/4 select primary/secondary/knife/grenade; wheel cycles; Q quick-knifes; G drops weapon.
Tab scoreboard; Escape menu. Controller: sticks move/look, triggers fire/aim, A jump, B crouch, X reload, RB use, LB grenade.
story: The game documents competitive matches between Ironclad and Nightwatch rather than a single-player narrative campaign.

characters.name: Ironclad
characters.description: Army-green and tan team whose soldier models carry field webbing, utility pouches and a small pack.
characters.appearance_note: Ironclad is a team rather than an individual character; its green-and-tan uniform appears across the selectable soldier appearances.
characters.image_caption: First-person Ironclad team view, with green uniform sleeves.

characters.name: Nightwatch
characters.description: Navy and black team whose soldier models use a plate carrier, radio and assault pack.
characters.appearance_note: Nightwatch is a team rather than an individual character; its navy-and-black uniform appears across the selectable soldier appearances.
characters.image_caption: A navy-and-black Nightwatch opponent beside the warehouse doorway.

characters.name: Rifleman
characters.description: Selectable helmeted soldier appearance; appearance is cosmetic rather than a separate combat class.

characters.name: Scout
characters.description: Selectable soldier appearance with a beret and headset; it keeps the same body and hitboxes as other appearances.

characters.name: Recon
characters.description: Selectable soldier appearance with a fabric hood and goggles; it keeps the same body and hitboxes as other appearances.

characters.name: Breacher
characters.description: Selectable helmeted soldier appearance with extra face armor and a narrow viewing panel; the body and hitboxes remain shared with the other appearances.
